label: preparing
what: Likely a private jubilee gathering or celebration in the great hall at day 1, 18:00, with bread and lighting, presented to the mayor as a lighting inspection. Builder, freight and innkeeper appear to coordinate it. Baker supplied bread knowingly as an order, but knowledge of the concealed celebration is not established. The secretary disclosed partial clues to the mayor, so complete secrecy is not established; the full purpose was not explicitly disclosed.
